rationale: The only candidate (9f8043e16f2e, 'Cascade SIGTERM to subprocesses') adds new SIGTERM-forwarding behaviour and touches this change's lines only to rename slurm_sigusr_handler_fn to a private name and reword its log message, leaving the configurable requeue-signal logic added here intact.

The only candidate (9b5c5938ceb7, 'Remove get_device call in switchbot') deletes the `or await switchbot.get_device(address)` fallback three months later without naming any defect, which reads as dropping a workaround that this change added deliberately for the already-connected-at-startup case rather than repairing a bug in it.

The candidate is a CI/packaging commit (titled as testing, with an unrelated package-name parameterisation) that swaps the three logger.info calls for print because log output was missing; those logger.info calls pre-date this change, which only appended version strings that the later commit keeps.

The only candidate (b8eaabe3c983, 'Add interruptible work') is a feature that adds a public interruptible field and turns the internal placeholder `self.preemptible = False` into `self.preemptible = self.interruptible`; the placeholder was not a defect.

The fix makes the pre-existing last_org-based logic also inject the organizations:customer-domains feature when a customer domain is used, a gap this change did not create, and the one blamed line it edits is only replaced by the equivalent helper is_using_customer_domain(request).

The only candidate (bf1323d138f6) is the planned step 4 of the same app_id integer-to-string migration and merely renames the app_id_str lookup kwarg back to app_id once the column is redirected; using app_id_str in step 3 was the intended intermediate state, not a defect.

The only candidate (e522a12d177f, 'Improve lightning connect experience') is a UX rework that removes the --yes option, so the recursive call connect(app_name_or_id, yes) merely lost its second argument while the disconnect-then-reconnect behaviour added here is kept.

The fix commit repairs an iterate-over-None error but in this file only adds typing, and the single blamed line it changes is the pre-existing `-> str | None` return annotation that this change merely re-wrapped while adding the lineno parameter.

The rewrite hard-codes `np.arange(c.categories.nunique(), dtype=np.int8)`, which wraps to negative values once a categorical has more than 128 categories, so the take indices for unobserved categories are wrong in groupby(sort=False); BUG commit 1294b193f0d0 drops the int8 dtype (candidate 2 edits a different `if c.ordered:` line and candidate 3 changes ordered-sorting behaviour carried over from the old code).

The only candidate (6842cdcb65c6, 'Clean up default ZHA entity names') is a naming clean-up that deletes the whole custom name property and _name in favour of _attr_name; the _attr_name override check added here was working as intended.

The only candidate (bf1323d138f6) is the planned step 4 of the same migration and merely renames the app_id_str constructor kwarg to app_id; writing app_id_str alongside app_id in step 1 was the intended behaviour, not a defect.

A same-day follow-up titled as a fix ('session replay banner setting', body 'Remove saas flag') deletes the is_saas() helper this change added, but neither its message nor this file's patch shows a functional failure, so it may equally be a redesign to a banner-specific setting.
